hints.title: Two Knapsack State Representation
hints.text: Track the maximum weight loaded into the second bag for every attainable weight in the first bag.

hints.title: Three Choice Transition
hints.text: For each item, consider placing it in bag 1, placing it in bag 2, or leaving it unselected.

hints.title: Max Combined Sum
hints.text: Iterate across all valid first bag weights and take the maximum sum of w1 plus w2.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: C1: Capacity of the first bag
complexity.notes: Computes best secondary bag weight for each primary bag capacity in linear space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining 3^N placement combinations across items leads to exponential runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains a 1D array of size C1 + 1 instead of a 2D matrix.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model the two capacities cleanly using 1D state optimization.
